Container.Name: Pipelinarr
Container.Overview: Pipelinarr is a deterministic, self-hosted movie release preparation pipeline. This private beta requires configuration and secret files to be bootstrapped before first start.
Container.Requires: Before installing, run the private-beta bootstrap script from the Pipelinarr source repository. The image is private and requires an Unraid Docker registry login with a GitHub classic PAT scoped to read:packages.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port used directly or as the reverse-proxy target. Container port 8080 remains unchanged.

Config.Name: Pipelinarr Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent configuration, secrets, database, logs, and templates for the private beta.

Config.Name: Pipelinarr Data
Config.Description: Private-beta inbox, work, completed releases, failures, and archive.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID. The entrypoint drops privileges after preparing mounted directories.
